link.title: FTP
link.description: ZennoPoster actions for working with FTP/FTPS: FTP connection (host, port, TLS/SSL, active/passive mode, encoding, timeouts, retries, availability check), FTP directories (listing, navigation, creation, deletion, masks and filters), FTP files (upload/download, resume, existence check, size/modified date, delete, move/rename). Supports operation logging and error handling.
